rows.label: tlk45400251_01_msg0001
rows.name:
That's an adorable Blade you're
traveling with, my dear!

rows.label: tlk45400251_01_msg0002
rows.name:
But since you're Drivers and Blades,
you knock down enemies and
launch them into the air...

rows.label: tlk45400251_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Then smash launched enemies
down to deal even greater
damage...

rows.label: tlk45400251_01_msg0004
rows.name:
You fight savagely like the Invidians,
don't you?

rows.label: tlk45400251_01_msg0005
rows.name:
You should fight with style and grace,
like Special Commissioner Meleph-sama.

rows.label: tlk45400251_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Oh, what I wouldn't give to be able
to have tea with her sometime...
